en: Pingyan's right. The dead can't come back, and Shen Gongbao already died in the Dragon God's cave. Let's pull ourselves together instead of grieving. Come, brothers! Jiuwan Village is nearby. Let's rest there!
Why's that uggo so slow? Is he dead? Hmph! Good riddance, he's SO annoying. No wait, he can't die yet. He's got a job to finish. Without the Phoenix Bone, Yunzhongzi won't teach me magic...
Chanyu~ I brought back the Phoenix Bone! Now we can finally get married!
Uggo! Don't come near me! Didn't I tell you to stay ten meters away when you talk to me?
Sorry! Sorry! I got carried away...
Uggo! Is that true? Then hand over the Phoenix Bone... Oh wait! Just toss it over! Don't come closer! I don't want your germs!
Okay! But before I hand it over, someone wants a word with you. Okay?
Talk to me? Who? I'm a very busy lady, you know. Hmph! Fine! For the Phoenix Bone, I'll put up with it. Well? Bring them out already!
That shrew calling him 'uggo' this and 'uggo' that... is she Deng Chanyu?
Looks like you called it, Beakface... But she clearly doesn't like Tu Xingsun one bit. If she's just using him, that'd explain it...

So that's how it is. To save Ancient South, whose life hangs by a thread, we can't give you the Phoenix Bone. Tu Xingsun kept his promise. I think you were testing his sincerity, and his love for you is beyond doubt. If you'll have him, my father will preside at your wedding. So please, let us have the Phoenix Bone!
Who are you? Yammering on and on! Why should I listen to you and marry that uggo?
But didn't you promise that once Tu Xingsun got the Phoenix Bone, you'd marry him?
Are you a pighead?! I only said I'd THINK about it! You think I'd marry that uggo for a bone? Let me be clear: if he were the last man on earth, I'd shave my head and become a nun...
This woman is just too horrible......
You're right, Beanpole! I-If she weren't a girl, I'd......
Hmph! Are you two done, Monkey-face and Birdman? Whatever you plan to do, I couldn't care less about you...
Why does this broad remind me of someone?
Don't hold back, Busybody......
Miss Yang Jian~ Whatever you want to say or do, we won't stop you... Go ahead and show your true self...
What're you on about?

Brother Ji Fa... I... I...... Fine, this lady gets it! Since you all know, I can quit acting cute! You country bumpkin! Your folks gave you a decent face, but your heart is as filthy as a demon's! This time I've had it!
Hmph! Where'd this middle-aged auntie come from? Should I post a 'lost senior' notice? Ha ha ha~
You dare sass me?! If I don't whip you today, my name's not Yang Jian! I'll knock your teeth out!
D...Darn it...
Now you know not to cross me! Wa ha ha ha~
Sorry, excuse me.........
Hey! Don't run... I'm not done with you yet......
Beakface, why are you spacing out?
...No way... Miss Yang Jian is actually...
......Pardon my outburst. I didn't scare you, did I?
Actually, we noticed long ago. We're all companions now, so just be your natural self!
Yeah! Quit pretending to be a lady......
Say that again! I swear I'll......
Ha ha ha~
Ha ha ha~
Now THAT'S you~
Why is even Brother Ji Fa picking on poor me~
Sorry. It's late. Let's hurry to Yunzhongzi for the elixir!
Yup! Beakface! We're leaving. Hurry up or we'll ditch you!
This can't be real...... This can't be real...... I'll never trust women again...
A Miss Deng came the other day wanting to be a disciple. Master doesn't take girls, so he gave her a test. What test, you ask?
Anything new happen lately?
B-Beakface!...... Tee hee
Leizhenzi, long time no see! How've you been? Master misses you too!

I see. So Deng Chanyu stole your Phoenix Bone. I sent her for it to put her off. If she failed, she'd give up; if she won, it'd lighten your load. I worried for nothing. You've really grown... And never forget the Dragon God as long as you live.
I'll never forget that the Dragon God saved my life......
No time to lose! Give me the Dragon Sinew and Phoenix Bone. I'll refine them...
With this, you can revive the dying Ancient South... Hurry back to Qilin Cliff!
I'll rush to Qilin Cliff at once!
Go to Qilin Cliff and save Ancient South!
Ancient South, it may be hard, but please swallow this elixir...
Ugh... Leizhenzi... thank you all... If not for you, this old life of mine would've been done for...
They say Ancient South knows all things. I have something to ask you...
You want to know how to get home, and where Xiaojun and Yin Wen are, right?
Wow, you're good. I hadn't even...
Of course! Ancient South is the most learned immortal in the whole world...
I get it! Beakface, quit butting in!
Why you......

There is a way home. You must crush Shen Gongbao's ambitions and help Jiang Ziya finish the Investiture. Then you can return to your world. As for Xiaojun and Yin Wen, don't go looking. They'll come to you soon enough. That is the fate of the Generals' Stars...
Generals' Stars? Fate? Could you be clearer? I don't get it...
I've said enough. Shen Gongbao's Cosmic Palm hurt my meridians. I must rest in my cave a few days. Until we meet again...
Oh! I forgot to tell you: disaster will soon strike Xiqi. Hurry back and save the city!
Xiqi is in danger! Then Father......
Beakface! Let's go! Next stop, Xiqi!
Roger! Beanpole!
R...Report, my lord! K...King Zhou sent a great army... h...heading for... Xiqi...!
Don't panic! I understand! You're dismissed!
What do you two ministers think?
My lord, this attack is no ordinary move. On the surface, it's to punish your escape from Youli. But in my humble view, King Zhou's true aim with so many troops is to wipe out Xiqi!
My lord! For Xiqi's people, our army must stop King Zhou's slaughter!
Understood! Fighting King Zhou is not rebellion. It's defending Xiqi's people!
Wisely spoken, my lord!
Spread the word! All troops on alert, ready for battle!
Yes, sir!
Let me go~ You stinking whale fiend!
Ha ha ha...... Stop struggling! They say it takes a hundred years of good karma to share a pillow. Our fated union is a blessing from past lives. We should cherish it! Isn't that right, my beauty?
Shut up! What past lives? What fate? That's disgusting!
Ho ho ho...... I understand. Come now, beauty, don't be shy...
Me? Shy? Enough............
Ho ho ho...... So cute. Oh! We're going to be husband and wife, yet I don't even know your name, my beauty!
Don't freak out when I tell you! I am Ji Pingyan!
Y-You say your name is Ji Pingyan?
That's right!
Now you get it, right! Actually, I'm......
Nice name, but a bit too manly... Oh well! It's just a name, no big deal! As long as you're pretty!
D-D-Don't come closer! You win, I'm scared!
He's not just manly! He's 100% man!
Whoa! Buddy! You guys made it!
Sorry to keep you waiting, buddy!
Still pure, Monkey-face? Tee hee hee!
You want to die, Busybody?!
M...Man?
Liar! You're just jealous of me, aren't you?
Then this lady will prove it to you!
Y...You're a guy?
Can't you tell?
D...Darn it~ You she-male! You tricked me! I'll get you for this!
S...She-male...?
Why're you just standing there? Get him!
D...Darn it... Today I'm beaten by you. Kill me if you must!
Spare him!
My lady......
Who's there?
What wicked folk dare run wild in my palace?
Lady Long Ji......
Wicked? YOU'RE the wicked witch! How rude!
W...Wicked folk... she...she-male...?
Monkey-face? You okay?
W...Wicked folk... she...she-male...? Sob......
Hmph! You barge into my palace and now you want to harm my adorable pet Whaley?
What did you...
Adorable pet? Ask your adorable pet what it did! It forced a village girl to become its wife! It even nearly... nearly... me......
Nearly what?
Shut up!
Whaley! Speak! Is this true?
Tell the truth!

Yes! Yes! Here's what happened. Half a month ago I snuck out of Lady Long Ji's palace, planning to settle at Yinmeng Lake. Suddenly I heard a moving melody from the lakeside cottage. As I listened, its sad, lovely music cast a spell on me... Curious, I went in to see who could play so beautifully... When I saw that maiden, I was stunned! A fairy come to earth? How could a girl be so lovely? And so my heart was stirred.........
Whaley, you've utterly disgraced me......
Forgive me, my lady... Forgive me...
Don't call me heartless! Prepare to die!
Wait! Any guy would chase a fair maiden, and that girl really is gorgeous. Besides, it didn't do anything unforgivable...... So spare it!
Thank you......... I, Long Ji, am grateful to you all...
Apologize to your saviors!
Yes, yes...... I was out of line. Please forgive me, kind Ji Pingyan!
Forget it! You didn't really do anything to me.
Ji Pingyan? Son of Ji Chang, Lord of the West, and Jiang Ziya's student? The one doing the Investiture for Jiang Ziya?
Yeah? And you are...? How do you know that?
I am Princess Long Ji, daughter of the Jade Emperor and the Queen Mother of the West. I failed to discipline Whaley, and he ran wild on earth... Let me lend you a hand! It will ease my guilt...
That's a great idea! The more the merrier!
Are you sure about this? This trip isn't sightseeing. It's a thorny road full of hardships, you know.
Please don't say that! I was banished to earth for breaking heaven's rules. This way I can atone and go back sooner!
You're too kind! It's not like we lose anything......
Ho ho ho...... Who knows what you two did before we got here......
What's that supposed to mean, Busybody?
Ho ho ho.........
Busybody! I'm warning you! If Beakface hears about this, you're dead meat!
Ho ho ho... Okay! Okay!
My child... how did you get here... Are you well? Let me look at you...
Thank you, kind sirs. You saved my daughter from that fiend...
Oh, it was nothing!
If not for Ji Pingyan and his party, I would have...
Wh...What? They're Ji Pingyan's party?!
You know us, sir?
Forgive me!
Hey hey hey! Are you kidding me?!
Father, weren't you just thanking them for saving me? Why turn your sword on them the moment you heard who they are?

My child~ I know... For a year I hid you at Yinmeng Lake under a false name. I thought my switch was flawless. But two nights ago, the new Imperial Tutor Shen Gongbao visited. He said the new ruler Wen Zhong has taken the throne, and His Majesty knows I sent an unknown girl to serve the late King Zhou in your place. Deceiving the throne means death for my whole clan. Only by slaying Ji Pingyan's party can I escape it......
Imperial Tutor Sh...Shen Gongbao! Yin Wen is emperor? H...How?!

After King Zhou died, Grand Tutor Wen became regent. He ruled well with Lady Daji and won favor. The land can't go a day without a king, and King Zhou left no heir. Then Imperial Tutor Shen Gongbao proclaimed Wen Zhong has royal Shang blood, and the court asked him to take the throne.
Ruled well?! Are you kidding? The people are suffering! Are those Zhaoge ministers blind?
Something smells fishy here!
You saved my daughter, and instead of thanking you, I feared for my clan and tried to wipe you all out... I...I............

Please don't take it to heart, sir. You did it out of love for your daughter. I'd do the same. Why not join the Xiqi army? You're not King Zhou's subject anymore. No need to serve Yin Wen... I mean, Wen Zhong! The court is rotten. A wise bird picks its tree. My dad, Lord of the West, is a true hero. He'll march on Wen Zhong soon. With you, he'd be unstoppable!
I'm truly ashamed.........
So you agree, Father?
No! Thank you, young man. Once a vassal, always a vassal. King Zhou is gone, but as a Shang subject I must stay loyal to the Shang.
Hmm... I understand!
Stay the night at my humble home. Tomorrow I'll open the pass and let you through! Let's pretend today never happened.
Thank you, sir~ But if you do that.........
It's no trouble! Go get some rest!
Okay!
Who knew Monkey-face could be so mature?
Was that a compliment, Busybody~?
Wh...Who's complimenting you? Hmph!
It's getting late! Let's turn in!
What a dimwit!
Sounds like people talking outside. I'll go look!
Huh? Isn't that my buddy and Miss Su?
Daji... once I've helped my buddy with Zhaoge, I'll come right back......... I won't let you suffer again. I'll protect you forever......
I'll be waiting for you!
Daji......
Best wishes to you both, buddy... It's late. Back to bed!
Xiaojun...... where are you?
Ho ho ho... That should do it! Tomorrow, the show begins!
So slow~
Weird. Where's your father?
He must have overslept! Let's not wait. I'll see you through the pass!
A...A demon?
Look out~ Nezha!!
Daji!!! Hang on! Wh...Why did you save me?
......Ne...zha...... I...can't...wait...for...you...to come back... I...if...in...the next life...we're fated... let's...be husband...and wife... Fare...well...... Ne..........zha............
Grr~ Grr~
You monster! I'll kill you!!!
Let's go, everyone!
I'll help you!!
Me too!
Die!
Stop! None of you lay a finger on it!
Trust me!
Got it! You'll be okay alone?
Yeah!
Grr~
I'll kill you! I'll kill you!
Stop, buddy! That's enough!
No need to say a thing! I understand.........
Look! The beast seems to be changing!
L...Lord Su!?
S...Sir? Why is it you?
Wh...What... have I... done...
L...Lord Su... I...
Don't...worry... It's...not...your fault......
It seems Lord Su Hu was controlled by some evil sorcery!
Who on earth did this?
Hu Ximei!? Was she sent by Zhaoge too?
I once heard my father say Hu Ximei is Lady Daji's right hand! Yin Wen and Daji must have sent her...
Yin Wen! From this day on, you're not my childhood friend anymore! I'll kill you! Yin Wen~ Waaah......
Monkey-face............
Lord Su is in a meeting. No entry!
This is Lord Su's residence. Outsiders, leave at once!
Please give Lord Su this hankie...
Understood! One moment, please!
Lord Su will see you. Come in...
Lord Su will see you. Come in...
Pingyan's so slow~ Did he forget?
Nah, no way, no way... Even with his lousy memory, he wouldn't forget. Still, that brat sure is taking his time.
Who're you calling a brat, Yin Wen~?
Gah! Trying to scare me to death? When'd you get back, brat?!
Sorry about that. I was out on a job with my dad and got all muddy... So I took a bath first when I got home.
Business seems really good for you lately, Pingyan~
Not bad! For some reason ghosts and monsters keep popping up lately. Why is that, I wonder?
Don't overthink it! Isn't that why your family business keeps getting better?
My money-grubbing dad says so too. Anyway! Enough of that. Come on in.
Oh! I've been to your house so many times, but I've never seen your basement! I really wanna go see it~
Yeah! Yin Wen really wants to see it too.
Yin Wen! You always take Xiaojun's side... Don't tell me you...
Qu...Quit guessing! So are we going down or not~?
No way! That's my family's ancestral forbidden zone! Absolutely not!
Okay, okay! We were just kidding. Don't be mad, Pingyan~

Heh heh... Actually, I wanna go down too! As a kid I wandered in once by accident. My feet barely touched the floor before my dad dragged me out. But he won't be home early today, so let's make an exception!
But remember! My dad must never find out...
Don't worry about a thing. Let's go!
Keep it secret, okay~
Free me~
Okay, okay!
Who's there?
What's wrong, Yin Wen?
What did you say?
.........No! It's nothing.
Yin Wen's acting weird!
Wow~ Pingyan~ Look, look! There's a pagoda with a sword stuck in it! And why are there so many seals on it? What does your family DO?
Even if you ask me, Xiaojun... I've got no answer for you.
No way! Your dad never told you anything?
Well, he did mention it... b...but I never thought it was true.
Don't be so mysterious, Pingyan~ Tell us~

They say the Ji family has a sacred duty: guarding the seal on Shen Gongbao's body in the North Sea. He's the villain who fought King Wu and Jiang Ziya's Investiture. If the seal breaks... Shen Gongbao will revive......... This is the Sword of Xuanwu, one of four holy swords. Only someone of royal blood like us can pull it out, so it should be safe.
Still, just in case, let's get out of here!
Oh! Where's Yin Wen? He hasn't said a word this whole time.
Ha ha ha~ At last, I've pulled it out...
Y...Yin Wen! Th...That sword only works for royal... blood......
What's so shocking? Didn't you know this guy descends from Wu Geng, son of King Zhou?
Th...This... You're not Yin Wen! Who are you?!
Ha ha ha~ After millennia, I, Shen Gongbao, live again! Jiang Ziya, you old fool, you're dead for sealing me! To celebrate, I'll start with a blood sacrifice of you lot!
Sh...Shen Gongbao!! You're Shen Gongbao!? Is the s...seal really broken?
Pingyan! You've caused a catastrophe! How will I ever face our ancestors?
Dad! You're back!
Be careful~ Pingyan!
Ha ha ha~ You think a father and son with such feeble magic can stop me?
D...Darn it~ Is there really no stopping him...
Who shall I start with? You! Little brat!
Are...you...okay~ Ping...yan............
Daaad~~~~
Ha ha ha~ Curse your weakness! Lucky you, my time is up... Ji Chang, Jiang Ziya, you old fools, just wait! I'm going back to the Shang to finish my conquest!
Daaad~~~~~~ Don't die~~~~~~ Aaaaaargh............
A small token of respect. Please accept it, sirs!
Wh...Why, you're far too kind...
Then please put in a good word for my father, Ji Chang.
Leave it to us! Prince Ji Fa.
Go home and wait for good news!
I used to suspect Ji Chang of disloyalty to Your Majesty. But my recent inquiries show he's devoted to the realm.
Besides, he even ate meat cakes made from his own son Bo Yikao... That proves his loyalty.
Put that way, it makes sense...
With unrest everywhere, I suggest freeing loyal Ji Chang and granting him a royal title. The Lord of the West will surely be grateful and serve Your Majesty well.
Right! Very well! You Hun, Shu Zhong! Release Ji Chang from prison at once.
As you command!
Lord of the West, please come out! His Majesty has freed you.
Is that true? His Majesty has decided to let me go home!
Indeed! Congratulations, Lord Ji Chang.
I must rush back to Xiqi tonight. If His Majesty changes his mind, my seven years here will be wasted.
Say, Shu Zhong~ Do you really think this was wise?
What do you mean?
Back then, we two killed Ji Chang's son Bo Yikao and made him into meat cakes. If Ji Chang goes home and leads Xiqi's troops here for revenge...
Y...You're right. We can't handle that! Tomorrow we petition His Majesty.
You say Ji Chang plans to rebel? Weren't you two vouching for his loyalty just yesterday?
Lord Shu~ Spies report Ji Chang is at the Zhaoge gate, about to leave!
Y...Your Majesty, this is bad! Leaving without a word means he's disloyal. If he reaches Xiqi, there'll be no stopping him.
Fools! Freeing him, then catching him, without a thought! Order Yin Pobai and Lei Kai to take troops and bring Ji Chang back now!
Yes, sire!
Lord of the West!
Oh n...no! I never thought they'd catch up so fast...
Lord Ji Chang, please stop! His Majesty wants you back.
Return? If I go back with you, I'm a dead man.
And you think refusing to come back will save your life?
Am I, Ji Chang, to die here?
Prepare to die!
Whoa~ Whoa~ Aaah~
C...Captain, wh...what's wrong?
Ow...that hurts... Where am I......?
He's...dead... Y...You rotten brat, I'll avenge the captain!
What the heck? Attacking me out of nowhere! What's going on here? I remember a huge gust of wind......
Thank you, young man...
Huh? You...you...? Sob~ Sob~
Hey mister~ What's wrong? Why are you crying? Something on my face?
Young man, you look exactly like my son. Same mold...
Really? Then he must be really handsome. I'd love to meet him!
That can never happen now... He... is dead...
Sorry~ mister! Was he killed by those guys just now?
I ate him to save my own skin... Sob sob sob~
Huh! A...Ate him? N...No way?

It's all because Daji and the traitors You Hun and Shu Zhong bewitched King Zhou. My son Bo Yikao tried to save me and was made into meat cakes... To survive I pretended nothing was wrong and ate my own son......... Sob sob~
J...Ji Bo Yikao? My dad said our Ji family descends from Ji Bo Yikao!
Wait! Hold on!! Daji? King Zhou?? Th...This is the Shang dynasty?! D...Did I end up in the Shang? And you wouldn't be J...Ji Chang?
Indeed! I am Ji Chang, Lord of the West. Young man~ from your clothes, you're not from our realm, are you?
I... forget it! I don't get it myself, and explaining is too much hassle.
I see. Oh! What's your name?
I'm Ji Pingyan!
J...Ji Pingyan? Your surname is Ji too?
Yep!

Your surname is Ji, and you look just like my late son Bo Yikao. Could heaven be giving my son back to me? Say, Pingyan~ I'd like to adopt you as my 101st son! What do you say? You're new here, so we could look out for each other, right?

What? Pick up a new dad on the road? Hmm... Pa would kill me. But he's the father of my ancestor Bo Yikao... so I guess it's fine, but... If I'm his son, won't I be my own dad's ancestor? Forget it! Thinking hurts! Anyway, I wonder if Yin Wen and Xiaojun came here too.
Of course I do! Your son greets you, Dad... I mean, Father!
Ha ha ha~ No need to bow. Let's go, or more pursuers may show up.
Once we're past Lintong Pass, we'll be a bit safer.
We've been expecting you, Lord of the West.
